data.one_liner: Tools for smooth following, camera shake, zooming, and rotating in Flame games.
data.what_it_does: Enhances Flame game camera functionality with extensions for smooth component following, camera shaking, zooming, rotation, and effect sequencing. It also provides group following and custom dead zones.
use_when: You are building a 2D game using Flame and need advanced camera behaviors.
You need camera shaking, smooth component chasing, or multi-target group follow.
You want to apply shake effects or chase behaviors to non-camera components like enemies or pets.
avoid_when: Your project does not use the Flame game engine.
strengths: Easy-to-use API for common camera tasks like zoom, rotate, and shake.
Supports group follow with automatic zoom-to-fit for local multiplayer.
Behaviors can be attached to any component, not just the camera.
weaknesses: Speed-based effect controllers are not supported for camera shakes.
Strictly tied to the Flame game engine.
data.setup_notes: Requires an existing Flame game project.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the base CameraComponent without additional advanced tool extensions.
